### End-of-slice verdict

- Five source commits (`a38f302` `:domain`, `2748c17` `:data`, `9417b1a` `:presentation`, `70ec958` `:ui`, `190cb81` `:composeApp` Koin + nav) plus a plan commit (`fdc9c8a`) and this close-out. Every source commit ≤5 files (commit 6 at the cap; others well under).
- Close-out (this SOLID entry + ARCHITECTURE.md §81) committed separately.
- Android compile gate: `:composeApp:compileDebugKotlinAndroid` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit. One mid-slice failure on Step 5 (`:ui` composable) with `Unresolved reference 'Icons'` — root cause: first `:ui` write used `androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.*` from `compose.materialIconsExtended`, which the `:ui` module's `build.gradle.kts` deliberately omits. Fix: rewrote the screen text-only (no icons, no `ImageVector` param on `StatsItem`); rebuild clean. Matches the established `:ui` posture (`LibraryScreen` / `DetailsScreen` / `ReaderScreen` all render icon-free).
- iOS compile gates: `:composeApp:compileKotlinIosArm64` + `:composeApp:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit that touched commonMain.
- Desktop compile gate: `:composeApp:compileKotlinDesktop` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit that touched commonMain (Step 5 `:ui` composable + Step 6 `:composeApp` Koin + nav).
- iOS framework linking + on-device smoke test: Windows-impossible; deferred to user's Mac. The primary smoke-test invariant — "open both routes on the same device, confirm the 8 numbers match" — exercises the crossover-correctness property of the strangler-fig impl.
- Layer boundaries: no violations. `:domain` (3 new files) has zero outward deps beyond `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow` and its own model. `:data` (1 new file) reaches into the legacy `:shared` `StatisticsRepository` via constructor injection — the documented strangler-fig boundary, mirroring `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl` (Phase 6.4.x.statistics). `:presentation` (4 new files) depends only on `:domain` + base `MviViewModel` from `:presentation/mvi/`. `:ui` (1 new file) depends only on `:presentation` (for the VM type) + Compose primitives — no nav/koin/platform/shared reach. `:composeApp` (1 new module + 1 new route adapter + 3 modified files) wires the slice at the composition root.
- Behaviour preservation: ✓ for current users — legacy `Screen.Statistics` route is unchanged. Both rework and legacy routes are reachable in parallel (rework via developer trigger only; legacy via the existing bottom-bar entry). Both consume the same legacy `StatisticsRepository` under the hood, so the user's accumulated reading-time + library counts agree across routes.
- MVI contract: new slice. Adds `StatisticsState` (9 fields incl. `isLoading`) + empty `StatisticsIntent` + empty `StatisticsEffect`. No reducer logic (state is flow-driven; `handle(intent)` is a no-op `when {}` over zero subtypes — trivially exhaustive per the Kotlin spec). Future user actions (e.g., a "Clear read time" button from a settings rework) slot in as new `StatisticsIntent` cases without VM-base-class parameter churn.
- Strangler-fig integrity: ✓ ONE `:data` → `:shared` reach (constructor injection of legacy `StatisticsRepository` in `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl`). Same boundary as `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl` (Phase 6.4.x.statistics) — already-established posture. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep from the prior slice carries through. Legacy `StatisticsRepository` and `StatisticsDeo` are READ from, never modified. The Phase 9.x route-swap can later retire the legacy facade and write a direct-Room impl when the legacy reader / library are also retired.
- Load-bearing fixes preserved verbatim: Statistics screen has NO images — none of the Coil ImageLoader / AVIF decoder / OkHttp fetcher / RGB_565 / allowHardware / HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder / maxBitmapSize fixes are touched by this slice. All `:ui` Reader fixes from §67-§80 (zoomable wrap, content-scale per layout, screen-height-Dp placeholder reservation, scrubber drive, resume-position, page X/Y label, ktor3 per-byte progress) — all `:ui` site, untouched. The slice is purely additive at the composition root and adds a new screen with no cross-feature interactions.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in `ARCHITECTURE.md` §81.9: no i18n lift (Phase 10); no per-manga / per-day granularity; no "Clear read time" action; no chart / graph rendering; no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x).
- **Next**: candidate slices for auto-continue per Rule 3:
  - **Phase 6.4.x.bookmark** — still blocked on chapter-identity decision (task #217; block-and-ask per Rule 8(d)).
  - **Phase 9.x.routeswap** — block-and-ask per Rule 8(b); not auto-continued.
  - **Phases 6-12 master (task #157)** — remaining non-Reader feature slices. Reader stack + Statistics rework done; remaining user-facing screens visible in the legacy nav graph that lack a rework counterpart: Home, History, Updates, Downloads, Sources (+ Source picker), Settings (+ many sub-screens), Theme, About, WhatsNew, Complaint, AdminComplaint, RepoSettings, LibraryManga (per-library-detail), WebView (host).

  Recommended next: per Rule 3, auto-continue. The Statistics rework is a model for the "small read-only feature with one repository observer" slice shape; reusing this shape, the next natural target is another read-only screen that surfaces aggregates or lists from existing legacy repositories. Top non-blocked candidates by simplicity: **History rework** (legacy `HistoryRepository` → `historyItemFlow`; one list, one search, one delete action — small but slightly more than Statistics), **Updates rework** (legacy update-notifications list; read-only with one mark-read action), **Downloads rework** (legacy download-queue list with per-row cancel/retry actions). Search rework is also visible but it sits across the source-fetcher abstraction (more layer surface — Plan-mode worthy on its own). The next firing should pick one and Plan a 3-7 commit slice mirroring this one's shape.

## Phase 7.x.history — History screen rework

Second post-Reader feature slice (Task #239). End-to-end port of the legacy History screen (`composeApp/.../features/history/ui/screens/HistoryScreen.kt`, a date-grouped reading-history list) into the new layer stack: pure-domain `HistoryEntry` model + one read+delete interface with three methods + three use cases + strangler-fig `:data` impl (with mapper) + MVI surface + `:ui` composable + nav route. Mirror posture to Phase 7.x.statistics' `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` (same legacy `:shared` repository dep, strangler-fig) but with mutating intents (delete-entry, delete-all) and navigational intents (manga-click, chapter-click). Both routes consume the same `history_items` Room table — deleting on EITHER route is reflected on BOTH; reading a chapter in EITHER reader (legacy or rework) updates the list on BOTH History screens. The crossover invariant is the primary smoke test.

### Design decisions (pointers to ARCHITECTURE.md)

- §82.1 — strategy (strangler-fig over the legacy `HistoryRepository`; rework `:data` impl reads + deletes via the same facade the legacy reader writes through; `mapper` round-trips `HistoryEntry ↔ HistoryItemD` for the entity-based legacy delete).
- §82.2 — layer-by-layer surfaces (5 new `:domain` files, 2 new `:data` files, 4 new `:presentation` files, 1 new `:ui` file, 2 new + 3 modified `:composeApp` files).
- §82.3 — date-grouping algorithm (legacy verbatim sans the JVM-only `toSortedMap` — substituted by `groupBy` + `sortedByDescending` + `associate` into `LinkedHashMap`; month abbreviation via inline `when {}` to keep commonMain-portable; English literal labels awaiting Phase 10 i18n).
- §82.4 — MVI shape rationale (canonical shape for list screen with per-row CRUD + nav: mutating intents fire-and-forget through `viewModelScope.launch { useCase() }` with upstream re-emission updating the view; navigational intents emit effects collected by the route adapter; no reducer mutates `items` directly).
- §82.5 — 14-field `HistoryEntry` payload (carries full reader nav arg tuple to avoid extra DAO round-trip at click time + crash-safety vs deletion races; Phase 9.x reader nav redesign can shrink as the legacy reader tuple simplifies).
- §82.6 — cover-thumbnail rendering (plain `AsyncImage(model = url)`; singleton `ImageLoader` carries AVIF decoder + OkHttp fetcher + size override + skia hi-quality decoder + per-source headers interceptor; load-bearing image-quality fixes inherit).
- §82.7 — files (5 source commits enumerated, all ≤5 files per commit; commit 6 at the cap).
- §82.8 — deferrals (no i18n lift; no icons; no undo-delete snackbar; no swipe-to-delete gesture; no per-manga drill-down; no bookmark action; no nav graph route-swap — Phase 9.x is its own slice).

### End-of-slice verdict

- Five source commits (`09a06f3` `:domain`, `dcb0158` `:data`, `c970856` `:presentation`, `6f389f3` `:ui`, `9c999ad` `:composeApp` Koin + nav) plus a plan commit (`385c655`) and this close-out. Every source commit ≤5 files (commit 6 at the cap; others well under).
- Close-out (this SOLID entry + ARCHITECTURE.md §82) committed separately.
- Android compile gate: `:composeApp:compileDebugKotlinAndroid` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit.
- iOS compile gates: `:composeApp:compileKotlinIosArm64` + `:composeApp:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit that touched commonMain.
- Desktop compile gate: `:composeApp:compileKotlinDesktop` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit that touched commonMain (Step 5 `:ui` composable + Step 6 `:composeApp` Koin + nav).
- iOS framework linking + on-device smoke test: Windows-impossible; deferred to user's Mac. The primary smoke-test invariant — "delete an entry on EITHER route, confirm it's gone on BOTH routes; read a chapter in EITHER reader, confirm the row appears on BOTH History screens" — exercises the crossover-correctness property of the strangler-fig impl.
- Layer boundaries: no violations. `:domain` (5 new files) has zero outward deps beyond `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow` and `kotlinx.datetime.LocalDateTime`. `:data` (2 new files) reaches into the legacy `:shared` `HistoryRepository` via constructor injection — the documented strangler-fig boundary, mirroring `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` and `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl`. `:presentation` (4 new files) depends only on `:domain` + base `MviViewModel` from `:presentation/mvi/`. `:ui` (1 new file) depends only on `:presentation` (for the VM type) + Compose primitives + Coil — no nav/koin/platform/shared reach. `:composeApp` (1 new module + 1 new route adapter + 3 modified files) wires the slice at the composition root.
- Behaviour preservation: ✓ for current users — legacy `Screen.History` route is unchanged. Both rework and legacy routes are reachable in parallel (rework via developer trigger only; legacy via the existing bottom-bar entry). Both consume the same legacy `HistoryRepository` under the hood, so the user's reading history is visible identically across routes; deletes propagate; new chapter reads insert.
- MVI contract: new slice. Adds `HistoryState` (2 fields incl. `isLoading`, + derived `isEmpty`) + `HistoryIntent` (4 variants: 2 mutating + 2 navigational) + `HistoryEffect` (2 nav variants). The `handle(intent)` reducer is a 4-branch `when` — sealed-with-4-subtypes is exhaustive; no `else` branch needed. Mutating intents fire-and-forget through `viewModelScope.launch { useCase() }` with upstream re-emission updating the view; navigational intents emit effects collected by the route adapter — canonical shape for a list screen with per-row CRUD + nav (see §82.4).
- Strangler-fig integrity: ✓ ONE `:data` → `:shared` reach (constructor injection of legacy `HistoryRepository` in `HistoryRepositoryImpl`). Same boundary as `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` (Phase 7.x.statistics) and `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl` (Phase 6.4.x.statistics) — already-established posture. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep carries through. Legacy `HistoryRepository` and `HistoryDao` are READ from + DELETED through (via the legacy `deleteHistory(entity)` / `deleteAllHistory()` methods), never modified at the class level. The Phase 9.x route-swap can later retire the legacy facade when the reader insert path also moves into the rework.
- Load-bearing fixes preserved verbatim: History screen's cover thumbnails render via the singleton `ImageLoader` set in `:composeApp/App.kt` — the AVIF decoder, OkHttp fetcher, max-bitmap-size override, HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, RGB_565 + allowHardware(false), and the `CoilSourceHeaderInterceptor` all apply by inheritance (no per-screen `ImageRequest.Builder`). Same posture as `LibraryScreen` / `DetailsScreen` covers (memory entries `project_yami_okhttp_fetcher` / `project_yami_desktop_skia_size_cap` / `project_yami_image_quality_buildrequest` / `project_yami_avif_decoder`). All `:ui` Reader fixes (§67-§80) — untouched. The slice is purely additive at the composition root.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in `ARCHITECTURE.md` §82.8: no i18n lift (Phase 10); no icons (`:ui` minimal-dep posture); no undo-delete snackbar; no swipe-to-delete gesture; no per-manga drill-down; no bookmark action (Phase 6.4.x.bookmark Task #217 is blocked); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x).
- **Next**: candidate slices for auto-continue per Rule 3:
  - **Phase 6.4.x.bookmark** — still blocked on chapter-identity decision (task #217; block-and-ask per Rule 8(d)).
  - **Phase 9.x.routeswap** — block-and-ask per Rule 8(b); not auto-continued.
  - **Phases 6-12 master (task #157)** — remaining non-Reader feature slices. Reader + Statistics + History reworks done; remaining user-facing screens visible in the legacy nav graph that lack a rework counterpart: Home, Updates, Downloads, Sources (+ Source picker), Settings (+ many sub-screens), Theme, About, WhatsNew, Complaint, AdminComplaint, RepoSettings, LibraryManga (per-library-detail), WebView (host).

  Recommended next: per Rule 3, auto-continue. The History rework establishes the "list screen with per-row CRUD + navigation" canonical shape (§82.4). The next natural targets reuse this shape: **Updates rework** (legacy update-notifications list; read + mark-read + navigate-to-reader/details — slightly more interactive than History, has a "mark all read" bulk action and per-row "mark read"), **Downloads rework** (legacy download-queue list; read + cancel + retry + delete + navigate-to-reader — most interactive of the three, has a long-press multi-select that may inflate the slice). Both are non-blocked and have established legacy repositories the strangler-fig can wrap. The next firing should pick one and Plan a 4-8 commit slice. Updates is the simpler successor; Downloads has more variants on the per-row action set and may need plan-mode if the multi-select inflates the surface.

## Phase 7.x.updates — Updates screen rework

Third post-Reader feature slice (Task #240). End-to-end port of the legacy Updates screen (`composeApp/.../features/notifications/ui/screens/UpdatesScreen.kt`, a date-grouped chapter-update notifications list) into the new layer stack: pure-domain `UpdateEntry` model + one read+mutate+delete interface with five methods + five use cases + strangler-fig `:data` impl (with mapper) + MVI surface + `:ui` composable + nav route. Mirror posture to Phase 7.x.history's `HistoryRepositoryImpl` (same `:shared` strangler-fig pattern) extended with two read-state mutators (per-entry `markAsRead` + bulk `markAllAsRead`) on top of the per-entry / bulk delete + observe surface History uses. Both routes consume the same `notifications` Room table — deleting OR marking-as-read on EITHER route is reflected on BOTH; the `LibraryRefreshWorker` inserting a new notification re-emits on BOTH; the cross-table consistency between a notification's `isRead` flag and the underlying `saved_chapters.isRead` flag is preserved (the legacy `LibraryDeo.markChapterAndNotificationRead` SQL bridges both columns in one transaction). The crossover invariant is the primary smoke test.

### Design decisions (pointers to ARCHITECTURE.md)

- §83.1 — strategy (strangler-fig over the legacy `NotificationRepository`; rework `:data` impl reads + mutates via the same facade the legacy worker inserts through; mapper round-trips `UpdateEntry ↔ ChapterNotification` for the entity-based legacy delete).
- §83.2 — layer-by-layer surfaces (1 new `:domain` model + 1 new repo interface + 5 new use cases, 2 new `:data` files, 4 new `:presentation` files, 1 new `:ui` file, 2 new + 3 modified `:composeApp` files).
- §83.3 — date-grouping convergence (Updates + History both `flatMap`/`flat-domain` the upstream and regroup in `:ui` using one shared 4-tier date-label idiom; converged on this posture to avoid a per-screen regroup variant).
- §83.4 — `LocalDate` (not `LocalDateTime`) for `notificationDate` (legacy `ChapterNotification` entity is day-granularity; rework preserves the wire shape verbatim — divergent from History's `LocalDateTime` because the upstream legacy entities differ).
- §83.5 — MVI shape rationale (extends History's canonical list-screen-with-CRUD-and-nav shape with two read-state mutators; mutating intents fire-and-forget through `viewModelScope.launch { useCase() }` with upstream re-emission updating the view; navigational intents emit effects collected by the route adapter).
- §83.6 — 14-field `UpdateEntry` payload (carries full reader nav arg tuple to avoid extra DAO round-trip at click time + crash-safety vs deletion races; same rationale as History §82.5).
- §83.7 — misleading legacy facade naming (`NotificationRepository.markAsRead(id: Long)` parameter is actually `chapterId`, not the notification primary key — the body delegates to `LibraryDeo.markChapterAndNotificationRead(id)` which runs `WHERE chapterId = :chapterId`; the rework impl forwards `entry.chapterId`, not `entry.id`, to preserve the legacy contract verbatim).
- §83.8 — files (6 source commits enumerated, all ≤5 files per commit; commit 6 at the cap).
- §83.9 — deferrals (no i18n lift; no icons; no undo-restore snackbar; no swipe-to-dismiss gesture; no per-row download button; no nav graph route-swap — Phase 9.x is its own slice).

### End-of-slice verdict

- Six source commits (`54b2487` `:domain` core, `28db8c2` `:domain` mark-read split, `9b1d105` `:data`, `bcdf9f5` `:presentation`, `5948216` `:ui`, `6990201` `:composeApp` Koin + nav) plus a plan commit (`da855ed`) and this close-out. Every source commit ≤5 files (commits 2 + 7 at the cap; others well under).
- Close-out (this SOLID entry + ARCHITECTURE.md §83) committed separately.
- Android compile gate: `:composeApp:compileDebugKotlinAndroid` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit.
- iOS compile gates: `:composeApp:compileKotlinIosArm64` + `:composeApp:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64` SUCCESSFUL on every source commit that touched commonMain (all of them).
- Desktop compile gate: `:composeApp:compileKotlinDesktop` SUCCESSFUL on the source commit that touched `:ui` / `:composeApp` commonMain (Steps 5 + 6).
- iOS framework linking + on-device smoke test: Windows-impossible; deferred to user's Mac. The primary smoke-test invariants — "mark an entry as read on EITHER route, confirm it's read on BOTH routes (and on the saved-chapters cross-table); delete an entry on EITHER route, confirm it's gone on BOTH routes; the worker insert path keeps populating both screens identically" — exercise the crossover-correctness property of the strangler-fig impl.
- Layer boundaries: no violations. `:domain` (7 new files) has zero outward deps beyond `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow` and `kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate`. `:data` (2 new files) reaches into the legacy `:shared` `NotificationRepository` via constructor injection — the documented strangler-fig boundary, mirroring `HistoryRepositoryImpl` / `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` / `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl`. `:presentation` (4 new files) depends only on `:domain` + base `MviViewModel` from `:presentation/mvi/`. `:ui` (1 new file) depends only on `:presentation` (for the VM type) + Compose primitives + Coil — no nav/koin/platform/shared reach. `:composeApp` (1 new module + 1 new route adapter + 3 modified files) wires the slice at the composition root.
- Behaviour preservation: ✓ for current users — legacy `Screen.Updates` route is unchanged. Both rework and legacy routes are reachable in parallel (rework via developer trigger only; legacy via the existing bottom-bar entry). Both consume the same legacy `NotificationRepository` under the hood, so the user's chapter-update list is visible identically across routes; mark-read flips propagate to the cross-table `saved_chapters.isRead`; deletes propagate; the `LibraryRefreshWorker` insert path keeps populating both screens.
- MVI contract: new slice. Adds `UpdatesState` (2 fields incl. `isLoading`, + derived `isEmpty` + `hasUnreadItems`) + `UpdatesIntent` (6 variants: 4 mutating + 2 navigational) + `UpdatesEffect` (2 nav variants). The `handle(intent)` reducer is a 6-branch `when` — sealed-with-6-subtypes is exhaustive; no `else` branch needed. Mutating intents fire-and-forget through `viewModelScope.launch { useCase() }` with upstream re-emission updating the view; navigational intents emit effects collected by the route adapter — extends History's canonical shape (§82.4) with two read-state mutators on top of the per-entry / bulk delete + observe.
- Strangler-fig integrity: ✓ ONE `:data` → `:shared` reach (constructor injection of legacy `NotificationRepository` in `UpdatesRepositoryImpl`). Same boundary as `HistoryRepositoryImpl` (Phase 7.x.history), `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` (Phase 7.x.statistics), and `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl` (Phase 6.4.x.statistics) — already-established posture. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep carries through. Legacy `NotificationRepository` and `NotificationDao` are READ from + MUTATED + DELETED through, never modified at the class level. The Phase 9.x route-swap can later retire the legacy facade when the worker insert path also moves into the rework.
- Misleading-naming preservation: the legacy `NotificationRepository.markAsRead(id: Long)` parameter is `chapterId`, not the notification primary key — the body delegates to `LibraryDeo.markChapterAndNotificationRead(id)` which runs `WHERE chapterId = :chapterId`. The rework impl forwards `entry.chapterId` (NOT `entry.id`) to preserve the legacy semantic verbatim — verified at the legacy call site (`UpdatesScreen.kt:151/233`'s `onMarkAsRead(notification.chapterId)`). Documented in `UpdatesRepositoryImpl` KDoc + §83.7.
- Load-bearing fixes preserved verbatim: Updates screen's cover thumbnails render via the singleton `ImageLoader` set in `:composeApp/App.kt` — the AVIF decoder, OkHttp fetcher, max-bitmap-size override, HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, RGB_565 + allowHardware(false), and the `CoilSourceHeaderInterceptor` all apply by inheritance (no per-screen `ImageRequest.Builder`). Same posture as `HistoryScreen` / `LibraryScreen` / `DetailsScreen` covers (memory entries `project_yami_okhttp_fetcher` / `project_yami_desktop_skia_size_cap` / `project_yami_image_quality_buildrequest` / `project_yami_avif_decoder`). All `:ui` Reader fixes (§67-§80) — untouched. The slice is purely additive at the composition root.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in `ARCHITECTURE.md` §83.9: no i18n lift (Phase 10); no icons (`:ui` minimal-dep posture); no undo-restore snackbar; no swipe-to-dismiss gesture; no per-row download button (Phase 7.x.updates.download is a future slice — blocked on lifting the `DownloadRepository`'s Android-only Koin binding to commonMain); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x).
- **Next**: candidate slices for auto-continue per Rule 3:
  - **Phase 6.4.x.bookmark** — still blocked on chapter-identity decision (task #217; block-and-ask per Rule 8(d)).
  - **Phase 9.x.routeswap** — block-and-ask per Rule 8(b); not auto-continued.
  - **Phase 7.x.updates.download** — adds the per-row download button to Updates rework; requires the `DownloadRepository` Android-only Koin binding to be lifted to commonMain first; that lift is itself a non-trivial slice (the legacy binding uses `androidContext()` for `WorkManager` access, and the rework `:domain` interface for a download surface doesn't exist yet). Reasonable next; would Plan-mode the surface before starting.
  - **Phases 6-12 master (task #157)** — remaining non-Reader feature slices. Reader + Statistics + History + Updates reworks done; remaining user-facing screens visible in the legacy nav graph that lack a rework counterpart: Home, Downloads, Sources (+ Source picker), Settings (+ many sub-screens), Theme, About, WhatsNew, Complaint, AdminComplaint, RepoSettings, LibraryManga (per-library-detail), WebView (host).

  Recommended next: per Rule 3, auto-continue. The Updates rework consolidates the list-screen-with-CRUD-and-nav canonical shape (§82.4 / §83.5) and introduces read-state mutators. Natural successors: **Downloads rework** (legacy download-queue list; read + cancel + retry + delete + navigate-to-reader — most interactive list screen; has a long-press multi-select that may inflate the slice; would need plan-mode), **Home rework** (legacy bottom-bar home; less interactive, primarily card-grid layout — closer to Library than to History/Updates; smaller slice), **Sources rework** (legacy source-picker grid; entirely read-side; smallest slice). Home is the simplest successor and the lowest-risk auto-continue target. Downloads is the highest-impact target but its multi-select surface would inflate the slice. The next firing should Plan a 4-8 commit slice for whichever is selected.

## Phase 7.x.sources — Sources screen rework

Fourth post-Reader feature slice (Task #241). End-to-end port of the legacy onboarding-flavoured Sources screen (`composeApp/.../features/onboarding/sources/SourcesScreen.kt`, a language-bucketed source list with per-source + per-language `Switch`es) into the new layer stack: pure-domain `Source` model + one read+toggle interface with three methods + three use cases + strangler-fig `:data` impl (with mapper) + MVI surface + `:ui` composable + nav route. Smallest list-screen slice in the catalog so far — no date grouping, no delete, no nav out, no `error` state — but the FIRST slice with a bulk-fan-out mutator (`setLanguageEnabled` snapshots the upstream and fans out per-source writes inside the `:data` layer, lifting that fan-out from the legacy onboarding VM). Both routes consume the same `sources` Room table through the legacy facade — toggling a source on EITHER route flips the same row, so the crossover invariant is the primary smoke test. The narrow ISP surface (3 methods, NOT the legacy's ~20) is the load-bearing posture preservation: the rework deliberately leaves `findRepoByHost`, `activeRepoFlow`, `repoTaps`, `getUrl`, `getEnabledRepos`, and `saveSources` UNTOUCHED on the legacy facade (those are consumed by the Coil interceptor, Home, Search, MangaDetails, Reader, and the onboarding seed — MEMORY: `project_yami_okhttp_fetcher`).

### Design decisions (pointers to ARCHITECTURE.md)

- §84.1 — strategy (strangler-fig over the legacy `:shared` `SourcesRepository`; rework `:data` impl reads + mutates via the same facade the legacy onboarding screen uses; `setLanguageEnabled` fan-out lifted from the legacy onboarding VM into the `:data` layer).
- §84.2 — layer-by-layer surfaces (1 new `:domain` model + 1 new repo interface + 3 new use cases, 2 new `:data` files, 4 new `:presentation` files, 1 new `:ui` file, 2 new + 3 modified `:composeApp` files).
- §84.3 — language grouping convergence (regroup lives in `:presentation` as a derived getter on `SourcesState`, NOT in `:ui` — divergent from History/Updates because Sources has no date-formatter render-time concern).
- §84.4 — MVI shape rationale (simplest possible list-screen-with-toggles; 2 mutating intents fire-and-forget, no nav intents, empty `SourcesEffect`).
- §84.5 — 4-field `Source` payload rationale (dropped `siteState`, `baseUrl`, `baseVersion`, `imageBaseUrl`, `imageUrlVersion` to avoid falsely advertising mutability of fields the load-bearing legacy facade owns).
- §84.6 — load-bearing legacy paths UNTOUCHED (explicit enumeration: `findRepoByHost`, `activeRepoFlow`, `repoTaps`, `getActiveRepo`, `getUrl`, `updateActiveByApi`, `getEnabledRepos`, `saveSources` — all served verbatim from the legacy facade).
- §84.7 — files (6 source commits enumerated, all ≤5 files per commit; commits 2 + 6 at the cap).
- §84.8 — deferrals (no i18n; no complaint dialog — OCP placeholder lives in empty `SourcesEffect`; no "Finish" button / onboarding chain; no `AnimatedBackground`; no "Languages coming soon" card; no siteState indicator; no sort-by-endonym; no nav graph route-swap).

### Files

Six source commits (plus the plan commit and this close-out):

- `a5d6f0e` — plan + commit roadmap (1 file: new `PLAN_sources.md`).
- `0c3e5ed` — `:domain` core (5 files at the cap: new `Source.kt` + `SourcesRepository.kt` interface + `ObserveSourcesUseCase.kt` + `SetSourceEnabledUseCase.kt` + `SetLanguageEnabledUseCase.kt`).
- `304bdf4` — `:data` strangler-fig impl (2 files: new `SourcesRepositoryImpl.kt` + new `SourcesMappers.kt`).
- `52ebf7a` — `:presentation` MVI surface (4 files: new `SourcesState.kt` + `SourcesIntent.kt` + `SourcesEffect.kt` + `SourcesViewModel.kt`).
- `3706c38` — `:ui` composable (1 file: new `SourcesScreen.kt`).
- `c837a29` — `:composeApp` Koin + nav (5 files at the cap: new `SourcesReworkModule.kt` + new `SourcesReworkScreenRoute.kt` + modified `ReworkModules.kt` + modified `Screen.kt` + modified `App.kt`).

### Per-file SOLID checklist

**`domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/manga/yamiapk/domain/model/sources/Source.kt`** (new — Step 2)

1. **SRP**: ✓ One rule — "a single content source as a value". No methods, no derivation, no Room annotations (those live on the legacy `SourcesEntity` in `:shared`). The mapper (`SourcesMappers.kt`) translating between this model and the entity is its own SRP island in `:data`.
2. **OCP**: ✓ Data class with `val` properties; field additions are additive with defaults; `copy(...)` keeps existing call sites working. The 4-field choice is OCP-friendly — when a future slice (e.g., a site-status indicator surface) needs `siteState`, the field appends to `Source` with a default value; existing call sites stay working (§84.5).
3. **LSP**: ✓ N/A (data class; not inherited from).
4. **ISP**: ✓ 4 fields — the minimum the screen reads. Drops 5 legacy entity fields (`siteState`, `baseUrl`, `baseVersion`, `imageBaseUrl`, `imageUrlVersion`) the rework slice cannot mutate and the screen doesn't render. Consumers see exactly what they can read + flip.
5. **DIP**: ✓ Zero deps. Pure-domain ADT; no `:data`/`:platform`/`:shared`/`kotlinx.datetime` reach (no temporal field exists on Sources).
6. **Layer boundary**: ✓ `:domain/commonMain`. Same layer as `me.manga.kira.domain.model.history.HistoryEntry`, `me.manga.kira.domain.model.updates.UpdateEntry`, `me.manga.kira.domain.model.Manga`, `ReadingStatistics`.
7. **No banned features**: ✓ No `!!`, `Any`, `lateinit`, `Thread`. All fields are primitives (`Int`, `Boolean`) or `String` — non-nullable (the legacy `saveSources` seed always supplies every field on first-run, and the toggle path only writes `isEnabled`).
8. **Naming**: ✓ Fields track the legacy entity 1:1 (`language`, `priority`, `isEnabled`) except `api`, which is mapped from the entity's `name` column — the legacy `saveSources` seeds the row with `name = repo.API` so the value is semantically the API identifier, not a display name; the rework exposes it as `api` to make the intent obvious (`SourcesMappers.kt` KDoc documents the renaming).
9. **KDoc**: ✓ File-level KDoc covers (a) the slice phase, (b) the 4-field rationale (the rework Sources screen renders only the per-source on/off toggle bucketed by language; the dropped 5 entity fields belong to the legacy routing surface — `findRepoByHost`, `getUrl`, mirror-domain editing — left UNTOUCHED on the legacy facade), (c) ISP correctness (carrying those fields would falsely advertise mutability the rework slice can't honour), (d) per-field KDocs on each of the 4 properties (with a note on what downstream the field feeds).

**`domain/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/manga/yamiapk/domain/repository/SourcesRepository.kt`** (new — Step 2)

1. **SRP**: ✓ Three methods, one rule — expose content sources as a read + per-source toggle + per-language toggle surface for the Sources screen. The interface scope is bounded by what the Sources screen needs; the legacy facade's routing surface (`findRepoByHost`, `activeRepoFlow`, `repoTaps`, `getUrl`, `getEnabledRepos`, `getActiveRepo`, `updateActiveByApi`, `saveSources`) is intentionally excluded — those stay on the legacy facade for the Coil interceptor, Home, Search, MangaDetails, Reader, and the onboarding seed to keep using verbatim.

- Desktop compile gate: `:composeApp:compileKotlinDesktop` SUCCESSFUL on the source commit that touched `:ui` / `:composeApp` commonMain (Steps 5 + 6).
- iOS framework linking + on-device smoke test: Windows-impossible; deferred to user's Mac. The primary smoke-test invariants — "toggle a source ON or OFF on EITHER route, confirm the toggle reflects on BOTH routes (and that the Coil interceptor still routes requests for newly-enabled sources via the unchanged `findRepoByHost` path); toggle a whole language ON or OFF on the rework route, confirm every source in that language flips and the legacy route reflects the bulk change; the Coil interceptor + Home / Search / MangaDetails / Reader keep using the legacy facade's routing surface verbatim" — exercise the crossover-correctness + load-bearing-paths-preservation properties of the strangler-fig impl.
- Layer boundaries: no violations. `:domain` (5 new files) has zero outward deps beyond `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow`. `:data` (2 new files) reaches into the legacy `:shared` `SourcesRepository` via constructor injection — the documented strangler-fig boundary, mirroring `UpdatesRepositoryImpl` / `HistoryRepositoryImpl` / `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` / `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl`. `:presentation` (4 new files) depends only on `:domain` + base `MviViewModel` from `:presentation/mvi/`. `:ui` (1 new file) depends only on `:presentation` (for the VM type) + Compose primitives — no nav/koin/platform/shared/coil reach. `:composeApp` (2 new + 3 modified) wires the slice at the composition root.

Both rework and legacy routes are reachable in parallel (rework via developer trigger only; legacy via the existing onboarding wizard chain). Both consume the same legacy `SourcesRepository` under the hood, so toggling a source flips the same `sources` Room row visible across both routes; the legacy routing surface (`findRepoByHost`, `activeRepoFlow`, `repoTaps`, `getUrl`, `getEnabledRepos`) keeps serving the Coil interceptor + Home + Search + MangaDetails + Reader verbatim.

The `handle(intent)` reducer is a 2-branch `when` — sealed-with-2-subtypes is exhaustive; no `else` branch needed. Mutating intents fire-and-forget through `viewModelScope.launch { useCase() }` with upstream re-emission updating the view; no navigational intents because Sources is terminal — simpler MVI surface than History / Updates (no effect channel use, no `LaunchedEffect` collector in the route adapter).

Same boundary as `UpdatesRepositoryImpl` (Phase 7.x.updates), `HistoryRepositoryImpl` (Phase 7.x.history), `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` (Phase 7.x.statistics), and `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl` (Phase 6.4.x.statistics) — already-established posture. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep carries through. ## Phase 7.x.theme — Theme picker screen rework

Scope: new `:domain` ADT + repo + 2 use cases; new `:data` strangler-fig impl over legacy `SettingsRepository`'s two boolean flows; new `:presentation` MVI surface (state + 1 intent + empty effect + VM); new `:ui` composable; new `:composeApp` Koin module + nav route adapter + `Screen.kt` entry + `App.kt` graph hookup. Seven commits (plan + 6 source/close-out), all <=5 files per commit. Smoke test deferred to user's Mac (Android emulator + iOS simulator). Build gates Android + iOS Arm64 + iOS SimulatorArm64 + Desktop GREEN at every source commit.

### Per-file SOLID 10-point checklist

#### `domain/.../model/theme/AppTheme.kt` (NEW)

1. **SRP**: ✓ One rule — "what theme variants the picker can show". Pure enum ADT with three variants (Light, Dark, System). No behaviour, no I/O, no rendering concerns.
2. **OCP**: ✓ Adding a new variant (e.g., `PureBlack` for the deferred Phase 7.x.theme.pureblack slice) is an append; existing `when (theme)` exhaustiveness in the `:data` impl will flag the missing branch at compile time.
3. **LSP**: ✓ Not applicable (enum, no inheritance).
4. **ISP**: ✓ Single concept per variant — no shared interface to bloat. The legacy app stored this as TWO booleans (`darkMode` + `followSystem`); the rework collapses them to one tri-state value, eliminating the "both true" and "both false-ish" coordination quirks at the type level.
5. **DIP**: ✓ Pure domain enum; no dependency on Compose, Coil, Room, or any other framework. Future picker shapes (radio list, segmented control, dialog) can render this ADT without changing the domain contract.
6. **Layer**: ✓ Lives in `:domain/commonMain/.../model/theme/`. Sibling to `:domain/.../model/Manga.kt` and friends.
7. **No banned features**: ✓ No `!!`, no `Any`, no `lateinit`, no `Thread`. Pure enum.
8. **MVI**: ✓ Not a state/intent/effect — it's the value type carried by `ThemeState.theme`.
9. **KDoc**: ✓ Three-paragraph KDoc covers (a) what the ADT represents (tri-state theme selection), (b) the two-boolean legacy collapse (legacy stores `darkMode` + `followSystem` separately; the rework's `:data` impl translates), (c) why it's pure (no Compose / no Material icon — the icon lookup is a `:ui`-local extension property).
10. **Strangler-fig integrity**: ✓ The ADT is the DOMAIN contract; the legacy two-boolean shape is hidden by the `:data` impl's `combine`-projection. The rework `:presentation` and `:ui` never see booleans.

#### `domain/.../repository/ThemeRepository.kt` (NEW)

1. **SRP**: ✓ One rule — "expose theme observation + mutation". Two methods: a `Flow` observer + a suspend setter. No business logic, no derivation.
2. **OCP**: ✓ Closed for modification (no implementation here). New surface (e.g., a "reset to system default" method) would be a new method addition; existing methods are stable.
3. **LSP**: ✓ Substitutable contract. `ThemeRepositoryImpl` (the `:data` strangler-fig) and any future direct-DataStore impl both honour the same shape.
4. **ISP**: ✓ Two methods, both used by the slice — no widow methods. The legacy `SettingsRepository` has ~20 unrelated members (language, notifications, adult-content, first-launch, etc.); the rework interface segregates ONLY the theme-related slice.
5. **DIP**: ✓ Interface in `:domain`; impl in `:data`. `:presentation` depends on the abstract interface (`ObserveAppThemeUseCase` / `SetAppThemeUseCase` constructor-inject the repo interface).
6. **Layer**: ✓ Lives in `:domain/commonMain/.../repository/`. Mirrors `SourcesRepository` / `UpdatesRepository` / `HistoryRepository` / `ReadingStatisticsRepository` / `ReadingSessionRepository`.
7. **No banned features**: ✓ No `!!`, no `Any`, no `lateinit`. `Flow<AppTheme>` is a pure type from kotlinx.coroutines.
8. **MVI**: ✓ Not part of the MVI surface; it's the domain abstraction that the use cases (and through them the VM) consume.
9. **KDoc**: ✓ Class-level KDoc covers (a) the slice (Phase 7.x.theme), (b) the strangler-fig hook (legacy `SettingsRepository.darkModeFlow` + `followSystemFlow` projected into `AppTheme`), (c) why no fallibility on the writes (sync `SharedPreferences.putBoolean` calls; no `Result`-wrapping), (d) parity with sibling rework repos (`SourcesRepository` / `UpdatesRepository`).
10. **Strangler-fig integrity**: ✓ The interface lives in `:domain`; the `:data` impl reaches the legacy `:shared` `SettingsRepository`. The rework `:presentation` + `:ui` never see the legacy class — same posture as `SourcesRepository` (Phase 7.x.sources) and earlier.

#### `domain/.../usecase/theme/ObserveAppThemeUseCase.kt` (NEW)

1. **SRP**: ✓ One rule — pass through to `repository.observeAppTheme()`. No transformation, no caching, no filtering.
2. **OCP**: ✓ Closed for modification. If a future slice needs to filter the stream (e.g., drop `System` while a UI-mode override is active), that's a new use case, not a modification of this one.

Same boundary as the five prior strangler-fig impls. The legacy `SettingsRepository`'s remaining surface (firstLaunch, language, notifications, adult-content, etc.) stays on the legacy facade verbatim for the legacy onboarding flow, `SettingsViewModel`, and the legacy `MainActivity`'s theme observer.

### End-of-slice verdict

- Files touched: 12 (1 plan + 4 new `:domain` + 1 new `:data` + 4 new `:presentation` + 1 new `:ui` + 5 new/modified `:composeApp` — split across 6 source commits, all <=5 files per commit). Plus this close-out (ARCHITECTURE.md + SOLID_AUDIT.md).
- Build gates after every source commit: Android + iOS Arm64 + iOS SimulatorArm64 + Desktop — all GREEN. BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 41s on the final commit-6 gate. Only pre-existing deprecation warnings; none from the new files (the `TabRow` warning matches the rest of the rework `:ui` posture).
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` <- `:data`; `:presentation` -> `:domain` use cases; `:ui` -> `:presentation` + `:domain`; `:composeApp` -> all. No reverse arrows. Strangler-fig `:data` -> `:shared` is the single permitted reach (same posture as the prior five strangler-fig impls).
- Behaviour preservation: legacy onboarding `Screen.Theme` route preserved verbatim (animated background, gradient overlay, notification-permission grant, "Continue" wizard advance, route adapter's boolean -> `AppTheme` translation, OnboardingViewModel's setTheme dispatch). Rework `Screen.ThemeRework` route is parallel + debug-guarded. Both routes consume the SAME two SharedPreferences booleans through the legacy `SettingsRepository` — toggling on EITHER route flips the same booleans and propagates to the other via upstream flow re-emit.
- MVI contract: new slice — adds `ThemeState` (2 fields, both used) + sealed `ThemeIntent` with one variant (`OnSelectTheme(theme)`) + empty sealed `ThemeEffect`. Constructor uses two `:domain` use cases (`ObserveAppThemeUseCase` + `SetAppThemeUseCase`). `updateState` lambda-style + protected `handle(intent)` abstract per established MVI patterns.
- Strangler-fig integrity: ONE `:data` -> `:shared` reach (`ThemeRepositoryImpl`'s constructor accepts `LegacySettingsRepository`). Same boundary as the five prior strangler-fig impls. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep carries through. The legacy `SettingsRepository`'s remaining ~16 members stay on the legacy facade verbatim.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in `ARCHITECTURE.md` §85.10: no i18n lift (Phase 10); no Material icons (rework `:ui` posture); no `AnimatedBackground`; no notification-permission grant; no "Continue" button; no PureBlack variant (future `Phase 7.x.theme.pureblack` slice via the empty `ThemeEffect`); no system uiMode fallback (future Compose-aware theming); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x).
- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no maxBitmapSize, no AVIF decoder). No load-bearing risk.
- Next-candidate block: per Rule 3, auto-continue. With Theme done (the smallest settings-sub-screen slice), the remaining settings-sub-screen catalog includes: **Settings rework** (the main settings hub — many sub-toggles, would need plan-mode to scope), **Language picker rework** (settings sub-screen), **About rework** (terminal display screen — straightforward), **WhatsNew rework** (terminal display), **Downloads rework** (download-queue list with retry/cancel/delete + multi-select — high-impact but inflated by the multi-select surface), **Home rework** (bottom-bar home, card-grid + per-source carousels), **RepoSettings rework** (repository management — overlaps with Sources but for a different table).
  - **Phase 7.x.theme.pureblack** — adds the deferred PureBlack/OLED variant via the empty `ThemeEffect` OCP placeholder + a new `AppTheme` variant + a new pref flow on the legacy `SettingsRepository`. Smaller than a fresh slice; reasonable as a follow-on if user-visible OLED requirements emerge.
  - **Phase 7.x.about** — terminal display screen; smaller than Theme (no MVI mutations — just a `Flow<AboutInfo>` projection). Lowest-risk auto-continue target.
  - **Phase 7.x.language** — settings sub-screen language picker; analogous shape to Theme (sealed ADT + tri-state-like projection over a single language pref).
  - **Phase 7.x.whatsnew** — terminal display, but the legacy carries a `isFirstOpen` nav arg + a "mark as seen" mutation; slightly more interactive than About.

  Recommended next: per Rule 3, auto-continue. About is the simplest successor and the lowest-risk auto-continue target. Language is the closest analog to the Theme slice's pattern (settings sub-screen pref-flow-driven picker) and would consolidate the canonical settings-sub-screen rework shape. PureBlack as a Theme follow-on would be the smallest non-fresh slice and validates the empty-effect OCP placeholder. The next firing should Plan a 4-7 commit slice for whichever is selected.

### End-of-slice verdict

- Files touched: 11 (1 new plan + 1 modified `:domain` interface + 2 new `:domain` use cases + 1 modified `:data` impl + 1 modified `:presentation` state + 1 modified `:presentation` intent + 1 modified `:presentation` VM + 1 modified `:composeApp` Koin module + 1 modified `:ui` screen — split across 4 source commits, all ≤5 files per commit, plus this close-out).
- Build gates after every source commit: Android + iOS Arm64 + iOS SimulatorArm64 — all GREEN. Desktop verified on the `:ui` commit (commit `70b0532`) — BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 44s. Only pre-existing deprecation warnings; none from the new/modified files.
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` ← `:data`; `:presentation` → `:domain` use cases; `:ui` → `:presentation` + `:domain`; `:composeApp` → all. No reverse arrows. Strangler-fig `:data` → `:shared` reach grows from 2 → 4 legacy facade members; same boundary, same posture.
- Behaviour preservation: the legacy `SettingsScreen`'s PureBlack toggle is preserved verbatim — toggling on either surface flips the SAME `SharedPreferences` key (`KEY_PURE_BLACK`) via the legacy `SettingsRepository.setPureBlack()` and propagates to the other surface via `legacy.pureBlackFlow` re-emit. First-run default (`true`) matches the legacy's existing default; existing users see no behaviour change.
- MVI contract: extends existing slice — `ThemeState` grows a `pureBlack: Boolean` field; `ThemeIntent` grows an `OnTogglePureBlack(enabled)` variant; `ThemeEffect` stays empty (the empty sealed interface continues as the OCP placeholder for a future `ShowError`). VM constructor grows from 2 use cases → 4 use cases; `init {}` now launches 2 independent `.launchIn(viewModelScope)` collectors (not a `combine` — the upstream flows are orthogonal and a `combine` would couple recompositions across fields).
- Strangler-fig integrity: ONE `:data` impl reaches `:shared` for the 2 new legacy facade members (`pureBlackFlow` + `setPureBlack(value)`) in addition to the existing 2 reaches. Same boundary as the §85 parent slice. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep carries through.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in `ARCHITECTURE.md` §86.8: no "PureBlack" tab in the TabRow (PureBlack is orthogonal to the tri-state, not a fourth variant); no system-uiMode-aware Switch enabled-state gate (matches legacy always-interactive posture); no animated transition between standard-dark and pure-black (Compose default cross-fade suffices); no `ThemeEffect.ShowError` variant (the empty sealed interface stays empty; sync `SharedPreferences.putBoolean` is structurally infallible); no i18n lift (Phase 10); no nav graph route-swap (both surfaces drive the same legacy facade calls; Phase 9.x is its own slice).
- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no maxBitmapSize, no AVIF decoder). No load-bearing risk.
- Next-candidate block: per Rule 3, auto-continue. With Theme + PureBlack done, the remaining settings-adjacent slices include: **Phase 7.x.about** (terminal display screen — lowest-risk auto-continue target; pure `Flow<AboutInfo>` projection with no mutations); **Phase 7.x.language** (settings sub-screen language picker; analog to Theme's pref-flow-driven picker shape but coupled with FeedbackDialog/ComplaintViewModel — more complex than initially scoped); **Phase 7.x.whatsnew** (terminal display with a `mark-as-seen` mutation; `isFirstOpen` nav arg semantics need attention); **Phase 7.x.settings** (the main settings hub — many sub-toggles, needs plan-mode to scope); **Phase 7.x.downloads** (download-queue list with retry/cancel/delete + multi-select — high-impact but inflated by the multi-select surface); **Phase 7.x.home** (bottom-bar home, card-grid + per-source carousels). Recommended next: **Phase 7.x.about** as the lowest-risk auto-continue target — it ports the smallest remaining display-only screen and validates the "no MVI mutations" extreme of the slice catalog. The next firing should Plan a 4-7 commit slice.

### End-of-slice verdict

- Files touched: 14 (1 new plan + 3 new `:domain` + 1 new `:data` + 4 new `:presentation` + 1 new `:ui` + 2 new `:composeApp` (Koin module + route adapter) + 3 modified `:composeApp` (ReworkModules.kt + Screen.kt + App.kt) — split across 5 source commits, all ≤5 files per commit, plus this close-out commit modifying ARCHITECTURE.md + SOLID_AUDIT.md).
- Build gates after every source commit (`eda7571`, `1d4ef1e`, `11d6cf1`, `bcd9d41`): Android + iOS Arm64 + iOS SimulatorArm64 — all GREEN. Desktop verified on the `:ui` commit (`11d6cf1`) and the wiring commit (`bcd9d41`) — BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Only pre-existing deprecation warnings; none from the new/modified files.
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` ← `:data`; `:presentation` → `:domain` use case; `:ui` → `:presentation` + `:domain`; `:composeApp` → all + `:shared` (route-adapter launcher injection). No reverse arrows. Strangler-fig `:data` → `:shared` reach grows by 1 (legacy `AppVersionProvider`); `:composeApp` → `:shared` route-adapter reach grows by 1 (legacy `IntentLauncher`); same boundaries, same posture.
- Behaviour preservation: legacy `Screen.AboutScreen` + `AboutScreenRoute` + `composable<Screen.AboutScreen>` block all untouched; legacy About screen unchanged. The rework `Screen.AboutRework` is a parallel destination with no in-app navigation entry yet (debug-only discoverability), so default end-user behaviour is identical to pre-slice. When the Phase 9.x route-swap lands, the rework route's version string + Check-for-update Play Store URI + Privacy-policy URL must render identically to the legacy.
- MVI contract: new slice — adds `AboutState` (3 fields: `isLoading`, `versionName`, `packageName`) + `AboutIntent` (2 variants: `OnOpenPlayStore` data object, `OnOpenUrl(url)` data class) + `AboutEffect` (2 variants: `OpenPlayStorePage(packageName)`, `OpenUrl(url)`). VM `init {}` launches `viewModelScope.launch` that calls `getAppMetadata()` once + updates state (no reducer, no Flow collector — single-shot state load). `handle()` exhaustively switches `AboutIntent` to emit the corresponding `AboutEffect`. Effects bridged to the legacy `IntentLauncher` via the single `onEffect: (AboutEffect) -> Unit` callback in the route adapter.
- Strangler-fig integrity: ONE `:data` impl reaches `:shared`'s `AppVersionProvider` (mirrors `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl` / `ReadingStatisticsRepositoryImpl` / `HistoryRepositoryImpl` / `UpdatesRepositoryImpl` / `SourcesRepositoryImpl` / `ThemeRepositoryImpl`). ONE route adapter reaches `:shared`'s `IntentLauncher` via `koinInject()` — same posture as Reader's `AndroidIntentLauncher` reach in `ReaderReworkScreenRoute`. No new `:shared` module touched; the existing `:data/build.gradle.kts` `:shared` dep + the `:composeApp` `:shared` dep both carry through.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in ARCHITECTURE.md §87.7: Whats-new row (needs `Screen.WhatsNewRework` destination first — separate Phase 7.x.whatsnew slice); Source-code row (already disabled in legacy; no behaviour to port); app-icon image (requires `:ui/commonMain/composeResources` binding for `Res.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground` — cross-cutting binary change deferred); SocialMediaRow (needs `material-icons-extended` which `:ui` deliberately omits — follow-on slice vendors brand icons locally); no i18n lift (Phase 10); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x); no `:platform` `IntentLauncher` rewire (Phase 8.z.platform-rewire lifts the launcher + version provider + toast shower triumvirate together).
- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no `maxBitmapSize`, no AVIF decoder, no HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, no Android RGB_565 / `allowHardware(false)` / OkHttp fetcher override). No load-bearing risk.
- Next-candidate block: per Rule 3, auto-continue. With About done, the remaining settings-adjacent screens include: **Phase 7.x.whatsnew** (terminal display with a `mark-as-seen` mutation; ports the legacy `WhatsNewScreen` over the legacy `WhatsNewRepository` — analog to About in shape; ALSO unblocks the deferred Whats-new row on the rework About screen — cross-cutting win); **Phase 7.x.language** (settings sub-screen language picker; coupled with FeedbackDialog / ComplaintViewModel — more complex than initially scoped); **Phase 7.x.settings** (the main settings hub — many sub-toggles, needs plan-mode to scope); **Phase 7.x.downloads** (download-queue list with retry/cancel/delete + multi-select — high-impact but inflated by the multi-select surface); **Phase 7.x.home** (bottom-bar home, card-grid + per-source carousels). Recommended next: **Phase 7.x.whatsnew** — small terminal screen (similar shape to About: one `Flow<List<WhatsNewItem>>` projection + a `mark-as-seen` mutation), AND porting it unblocks the deferred Whats-new row on About (cross-cutting win). The next firing should Plan a 4-6 commit slice.

- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no `maxBitmapSize`, no AVIF decoder, no HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, no Android RGB_565 / `allowHardware(false)` / OkHttp fetcher override). ## Phase 7.x.language.request — Request-Language dialog + Snackbar feedback

### End-of-slice verdict

- Files touched: 9 (1 new plan + 2 new `:domain` + 1 new `:data` + 4 modified `:presentation` + 1 modified `:ui` + 1 modified `:composeApp` Koin module). Split across 6 source commits + 1 close-out commit modifying ARCHITECTURE.md + SOLID_AUDIT.md. All ≤5 files per commit per the standing cap; the compressed commit `b705868` lands exactly at the cap (5 files: 4 `:presentation` + 1 `:composeApp`).
- Build gates after every source commit (`4ef17ac`, `787ba68`, `b705868`, `fd32995`): Android + iOS Arm64 + iOS SimulatorArm64 — all GREEN. Desktop verified on commit `fd32995` (`:ui` change) — BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Only pre-existing deprecation warnings; none from the new/modified files.
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` ← `:data`; `:presentation` → `:domain` use cases; `:ui` → `:presentation` + `:domain`; `:composeApp` → all + `:shared` (via the rework `:data` impl's strangler-fig reach to the 3 legacy collaborators). No reverse arrows. Strangler-fig `:data` → `:shared` reach grows by THREE (`SendComplaintUseCase` + `UserIdProvider` + `DeviceInfoProvider` — all already bound `single` by existing `:shared`/Platform modules; no new platform-specific code).
- Behaviour preservation: legacy `Screen.LanguageScreen` + `LanguageScreenRoute` + `composable<Screen.LanguageScreen>` block all untouched; legacy FeedbackDialog + `ComplaintViewModel.submit` path untouched. Rework `Screen.LanguageRework` now hosts the Request-Language flow writing to the SAME Firestore collection with the SAME `userId`/`type`/`subject`/`metadata` shape as the legacy path — admin dashboard reads either path's submissions identically.
- MVI contract: APPEND-ONLY extension of the foundation surface. `LanguageState` +3 fields, `LanguageIntent` +4 variants, `LanguageEffect` 0→2 variants (was empty), `LanguageViewModel` +1 ctor param + 4 `when` branches. The foundation's `OnSelectLanguage` branch is untouched; the foundation's `selectedCode`/`languages`/`isLoading` fields keep their semantics. Re-entrance guard on `OnSubmitRequest` (same posture as Details slice's `onRetry`). Fire-and-forget launch on `OnSubmitRequest` so `handle()` returns promptly.
- Strangler-fig integrity: ONE new `:data` impl (`FeedbackRepositoryImpl`) reaching THREE legacy `:shared` collaborators (`SendComplaintUseCase` + `UserIdProvider` + `DeviceInfoProvider`). Mirrors `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl`'s 1-collaborator posture from Phase 6.4.x.statistics, scaled up to 3. All 3 collaborators are already bound `single` in existing Koin modules (`SharedModule` for `SendComplaintUseCase`; platform-specific `PlatformModule.android/.ios/.desktop` for `UserIdProvider` + `DeviceInfoProvider`). ZERO new `:shared` modifications; existing build configs carry through.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in ARCHITECTURE.md §93.8: no i18n lift (all inline literals stay for Phase 10); no Retry action label on the failure snackbar (dialog stays open with text preserved — the Retry affordance would be redundant); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x); no rework `ComplaintScreen` port (separate `Phase 7.x.complaint` slice if needed).
- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no `maxBitmapSize`, no AVIF decoder, no HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, no Android RGB_565 / `allowHardware(false)` / OkHttp fetcher override). No load-bearing risk.
- Next-candidate block: per Rule 3, auto-continue. With the language thread now fully closed (foundation + Request-Language sub-slice), candidate set narrows: **(A) fresh feature slices** — `Phase 7.x.settings` (main settings hub — many sub-toggles, plan-mode required, biggest unported user-facing surface, several rows trigger sub-dialogs analogous to Request-Language so this slice's effect-to-snackbar pattern will reuse cleanly), `Phase 7.x.downloads` (download-queue list with retry/cancel/delete + multi-select — sizeable; would exercise selection-state + multi-action MVI surface analogous to Library's bulk-remove), `Phase 7.x.home` (bottom-bar home, card-grid + per-source carousels — large; cross-source orchestration), `Phase 7.x.complaint` (standalone Complaint screen rework — would reuse the same `FeedbackRepository` interface this slice introduced, extending it with `sendBugReport` / `sendFeatureRequest` siblings, OR re-port the legacy `ComplaintViewModel` as a full rework `ComplaintViewModel`); **(B) remaining WhatsNew sub-slices** (`.navbuttons`, `.images`, `.video`, `.fullscreen`, `.gate`, `.i18n`). Recommended next: **Phase 7.x.complaint** — natural follow-on from Phase 7.x.language.request (would extend the same `FeedbackRepository` interface; the legacy `ComplaintScreen` is structurally similar to the FeedbackDialog this slice ported). Alternatively: **Phase 7.x.settings** — biggest deferred user-facing surface; lots of internal complexity but no single block-and-ask trigger evident from a survey.

- Files touched: 14 (1 new plan + 3 new `:domain` + 1 new `:data` + 4 new `:presentation` + 1 new `:ui` + 2 new `:composeApp` + 3 modified `:composeApp` + 2 modified docs). Split across 7 commits — plan (1) + `:domain` (1 commit, 3 files) + `:data` (1 commit, 1 file) + `:presentation` (1 commit, 4 files) + `:ui` (1 commit, 1 file) + `:composeApp` wiring (1 commit, 5 files at the cap) + close-out (1 commit, 2 docs). All ≤5 files per commit per the standing cap. Commit 6 (`64637c1`) lands exactly at the 5-file cap.
- Build gates after every source commit (`63b4a7f`, `7c69594`, `4c72742`, `4bf7cf3`, `64637c1`): Android + iOS Arm64 + iOS SimulatorArm64 — all GREEN. Desktop verified on the `:ui` commit (`4bf7cf3`) and the nav-wiring commit (`64637c1`) — BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Pre-`:ui` commits don't link into the Desktop entry point but commonMain compiles green there too. Only pre-existing legacy-side deprecation warnings; none from the new files.
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` ← `:data`; `:presentation` → `:domain` use cases; `:ui` → `:presentation` + `:domain`; `:composeApp` → all + `:shared` (via the rework `:data` impl's strangler-fig reach to the 2 legacy collaborators). No reverse arrows. Strangler-fig `:data` → `:shared` reach grows by TWO (`GetUserComplaintUseCase` + `UserIdProvider` — both already bound `single` by existing modules from §93 and earlier slices; no new platform-specific code).
- Behaviour preservation: legacy `Screen.Complaint` + `ComplaintScreenRoute` + `composable<Screen.Complaint>` block all untouched; legacy `ComplaintViewModel` + reply/edit/delete dialogs + `ToastShower` wiring + onHelp TODO untouched. Admin-side `Screen.ComplaintAdmin` + `AdminComplaintScreenRoute` completely untouched. Rework `Screen.ComplaintRework` is a parallel debug-reachable route reading the SAME Firestore `complaints` collection (admin reads + Request-Language writes from §93 surface on both — the smoke-test invariant).
- MVI contract: new slice. `ComplaintState` (6 fields, 4-way mutual-exclusive render contract), `ComplaintIntent` (4 variants: 2 data class + 2 data object), `ComplaintEffect` (empty sealed interface — extensibility hook for actions slice), `ComplaintViewModel` (1-ctor-dep, `init { loadList() }`, exhaustive `handle()`). VM-side filter derivation via imperative recompute (matches Sources slice precedent; not `combine`-flow). NO re-entrance guard on `loadList()` today (documented as a known choice with the lift path noted).
- Strangler-fig integrity: ONE new `:data` impl (`ComplaintListRepositoryImpl`) reaching TWO legacy `:shared` collaborators (`GetUserComplaintUseCase` + `UserIdProvider`). Narrower than §93's 3-collaborator posture (LIST needs neither `SendComplaintUseCase` nor `DeviceInfoProvider`). Both collaborators are already bound `single` in existing Koin modules. ZERO new `:shared` modifications; existing build configs carry through. ONE additional banned-type containment: the legacy `Complaint.metadata: Map<String, Any>?` field is dropped at the `:data → :domain` boundary (banned `Any` excluded from `:domain`); the LIST view doesn't render metadata.
- Deliberate deferrals captured in ARCHITECTURE.md §94.7: no i18n lift (all inline literals stay for Phase 10); no row-tap action surface (reply/edit/delete dialogs defer to `Phase 7.x.complaint.actions`); no pull-to-refresh (legacy doesn't have one either; `OnRetry` doubles as manual refresh; PTR is additive if needed); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x); no admin-side rework (separate `Phase 7.x.complaint.admin` slice if needed); no metadata exposure (banned-`Any` containment; if a future feature needs it, a typed `ComplaintDeviceInfo` data class + migration use case would lift the data into `:domain`).
- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no `maxBitmapSize`, no AVIF decoder, no HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, no Android RGB_565 / `allowHardware(false)` / OkHttp fetcher override). No load-bearing risk.

## Phase 7.x.complaint.actions — Reply / Edit / Delete inline dialogs rework

Natural follow-on to §94's user-side LIST foundation. §94's `ComplaintEffect` was deliberately declared as an empty sealed interface — the OCP extensibility hook for exactly this slice. The legacy `composeApp/.../ComplaintActionDialog.kt` (696 lines, 4 dialog sub-screens: Menu / Reply / Edit / Delete) lifts into a `:ui` composable driven by the MVI state-machine instead of the legacy's local `var currentAction by remember { mutableStateOf(DialogAction.NONE) }`. The plan's projected 7 commits collapsed to 6 (the Koin module update had to ship in the same commit as the VM constructor expansion — otherwise the build would break between commits; documented as a natural fit-the-files arrangement, not a roadmap deviation).

## Phase 7.x.settings.foundation — Settings hub screen rework

The Settings hub is the most-trafficked screen of the legacy app and the biggest deferred user-facing surface. The legacy `composeApp/.../features/settings/ui/screens/SettingsScreen.kt` (407 lines) is a fused composable that owns 5 boolean toggle rows, 9 navigation rows, dark-mode conditional visibility, the ReadingMode dialog, the Feedback dialog, the CBZ-progress dialog, an admin testing-mode switch, the Clear-cache action with okio cache-folder file walk, and the app-header image. The foundation slice ports the load-bearing subset (5 toggles + 6 nav rows + clear-cache) and defers the dialog-heavy surfaces (ReadingMode / Feedback / CBZ progress) and the admin / Downloads / Help / themegating / header extras to sibling sub-slices via OCP-additive sealed-interface variants. The strangler-fig posture mirrors §85 (Theme) / §92 (Language) / §87 (About): one new `:data` impl over the same `:shared` `SettingsRepository` facade. No new `:shared` modifications.

- Files touched: 20 (1 new plan + 5 new `:domain` + 1 new `:data` + 5 new `:presentation` + 1 new `:ui` + 1 new `:composeApp` Koin module + 3 modified `:composeApp` (ReworkModules.kt + Screen.kt + App.kt) + 1 new `:composeApp` route adapter + 2 modified docs). Split across 7 commits — plan (1) + `:domain` (5) + `:data` (1) + `:presentation` (5) + `:ui` (1) + `:composeApp` Koin + nav (5 at the cap) + close-out (2 docs). All ≤5 files per commit per the standing cap. Commit 6 (`0a557f9`) lands exactly at the 5-file cap (SettingsReworkModule.kt NEW + ReworkModules.kt MOD + Screen.kt MOD + SettingsReworkScreenRoute.kt NEW + App.kt MOD).
- Build gates after the final source commit (`0a557f9`): Android — GREEN (39s); iOS Arm64 — GREEN (1m 43s); iOS SimulatorArm64 — GREEN (1m 45s); Desktop — GREEN (1m 43s). All 4 verified in parallel. Pre-`:ui` commits don't link into the Desktop entry point but commonMain compiles green there too. Only pre-existing legacy-side deprecation warnings; none from the new files. iOS framework linking + on-device smoke tests deferred to user's Mac.
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` ← `:data`; `:presentation` → `:domain` use cases (3 of them); `:ui` → `:presentation` + `:domain`; `:composeApp` → all + `:shared` (via the rework `:data` impl's strangler-fig reach to the legacy `SettingsRepository` facade + the route adapter's `Admin.isAdmin` read). No reverse arrows. The `:ui` module deliberately depends on `:presentation` (which knows the VM) but NOT on `androidx.navigation` (the route adapter is the FIRST layer that knows about `NavController` + `Screen` types).
- Behaviour preservation: legacy `Screen.Setting` + `SettingsRoute` + legacy `SettingsViewModel` + legacy 407-line `SettingsScreen.kt` (with dark-mode gating + ReadingMode dialog + Feedback dialog + CBZ progress + admin testing-mode surfaces + app-header image + 9 nav rows including Downloads/Help/WhatsNew) — ALL untouched. Rework `Screen.SettingsRework` is a parallel debug-reachable route operating on the SAME upstream wire — toggling a switch on EITHER screen flips the same `SharedPreferences` / `DataStore` key; cache clear on EITHER screen runs the same `clearFilesLargerThan1MB()`. Smoke-test invariant holds by construction.
- MVI contract: new slice. `SettingsState` (8 fields: 5 toggle booleans + cacheSize + isLoading + isClearingCache), `SettingsIntent` (3 variants: OnToggle + OnClearCache + OnNavigate), `SettingsEffect` (2 variants: NavigateTo + ShowSnackbar), `SettingsDestination` (6 variants: THEME/STATISTICS/LANGUAGE/ABOUT/COMPLAINT/WHATSNEW), `SettingsViewModel` (3-arg ctor, exhaustive `handle()` over the 3 intents, `init {}` flow observer, in-flight re-entrance guard on OnClearCache, 3-level message-fallback chain on snackbar failures). Effect-as-callback-bridge for the nav variant (single-receiver Channel + `:ui` nav-agnostic constraint).
- Strangler-fig integrity: ONE new `:data` impl (`SettingsRepositoryImpl`) reaching ONE legacy `:shared` collaborator (`SettingsRepository` facade — already bound `single` in `SharedModule` since Phase 7.x.theme). SAME boundary as §85 Theme / §87 About / §92 Language. ZERO new `:shared` modifications; existing build configs carry through. `DispatcherProvider` from `:core` (already `single`-bound in `CoreModule`).
- Deliberate deferrals captured in ARCHITECTURE.md §96.9: no dark-mode gating (UI-only `if (!state.followSystemTheme)` wrap; `Phase 7.x.settings.themegating` sub-slice — no MVI surface change needed); no ReadingMode dialog (`Phase 7.x.settings.readingmode` sub-slice — additive intents/state); no Feedback dialog (`Phase 7.x.settings.feedback` sub-slice); no Downloads nav row (depends on `Phase 7.x.downloads` rework target); no Help nav row (depends on real `:platform` `IntentLauncher` Help URL); no CBZ-conversion progress dialog (depends on Chapters VM rework); no admin testing-mode switch (depends on `Admin.testingMode` Compose state in `:composeApp`); no app-header image (needs `:ui` compose-resources binding — Phase 10 lift); no i18n lift (all labels stay inline literal — Phase 10); no nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x).

## Phase 7.x.settings.feedback — Feedback dialog on rework Settings hub

Closes the second deferral from §96.9 ("No Feedback dialog"). Adds the "Request feature / bug" entry row + the inline modal Feedback dialog (category dropdown + body field + Submit / Cancel) to the rework Settings hub. Re-uses §93's already-bound `FeedbackRepository` `single` via a new generic `submit(type, subject, body)` interface method; the original `sendLanguageRequest(body)` becomes a default-impl wrapper that pins type + subject and delegates to `submit`. ZERO new `:data` → `:shared` reaches — the §93 impl's 3-`:shared`-dep orchestration carries both flows unchanged.

The new `submit(type, subject, body)` generalises the surface; `sendLanguageRequest(body)` becomes a narrow wrapper. Validation still lives in the legacy `SendComplaintUseCase` `require` blocks; the repository is pure transport.
2. **OCP**: ✅ The default-impl wrapper is the OCP-canonical pattern for evolving an interface — old call sites (language picker) keep their narrow signature; new call sites (settings feedback) consume the generic shape. Adding a third pinned wrapper later (e.g., `sendSiteAddRequest(body)` for a hypothetical site-add picker) follows the same pattern.

5. **DIP**: ✅ Consumers depend on this `:domain` interface, never on the legacy `:shared` facade or Firestore directly. The new `LANGUAGE_REQUEST_SUBJECT` companion constant is part of the contract surface; consumers can reference it without leaking the literal.
6. **Layer**: ✅ Pure `:domain/commonMain/.../repository/`. The `ComplaintType` reference is `:domain/.../model/complaint/ComplaintType` (introduced in §94); no reach to `:shared`.

## Phase 7.x.complaint.admin.actions — admin mutations slice (status-change / closure-reason / delete)

Natural follow-on to §101's admin LIST foundation. §101's `AdminComplaintEffect` was deliberately declared as an empty sealed interface — the OCP §6 extensibility hook for exactly this slice. Mirrors the user-side foundation → actions progression (§94 → §95). 7-commit roadmap collapsed to 6 source commits + close-out (the Koin module update had to ship in the same commit as the VM constructor expansion to keep the build green — documented as a natural fit-the-files arrangement, not a roadmap deviation).

### End-of-slice verdict

- Files touched: 14 across 7 commits — plan (`PLAN_complaint_admin_actions.md`, `22e2a17`) / domain (4 files, `52e8bb0`) / data (1 file, `2cfaff3`) / presentation+Koin (5 files at the cap, `5c8236b`) / ui (2 files, `db05068`) / close-out (this commit, 2 files). All commits ≤5 files (commit 4 at the cap; all others well under). The plan's "commit 6 = Koin polish" rolled into commit 4 because the VM constructor expansion could not ship without the matching Koin update without breaking the build.
- Build gates after every source commit (2-5): Android — GREEN; iOS Arm64 — GREEN; iOS SimulatorArm64 — GREEN. All 3 verified in parallel for each commit; only pre-existing legacy-side deprecation warnings; none from the new code. iOS framework linking + on-device smoke tests deferred to user's Mac.
- Layer boundaries respected: `:domain` (4 new files — interface + 3 use cases), `:data` (1 new file — strangler-fig impl with 4 `:shared` reaches), `:presentation` (4 modified files — State + Intent + Effect + VM extended; 1 modified for Koin), `:ui` (1 new + 1 modified — dialog + screen wiring), `:composeApp` (Koin module modified — bundled with commit 4). No cross-layer reach beyond the strangler-fig `:data` → `:shared` permitted boundary.
- Behaviour preservation: legacy `Screen.ComplaintAdmin` route remains bound to legacy `AdminComplaintScreenRoute` in `App.kt` (untouched). The rework admin screen now exposes 3 mutations side-by-side with the legacy admin screen's same 3 mutations — both eventually write through the SAME upstream Firestore `complaints` collection via the legacy `UpdateComplaintUseCase` / `DeleteComplaintUseCase`. No data divergence between the two paths.
- MVI contract: ADDITIVE extension of foundation §101 — state grows from 7 fields to 10 + 1 enum; intents grow from 5 to 11 (sealed); effects grow from 0 to 2 (sealed). VM ctor widens from 1 to 4 use cases. Exhaustive `when (intent)` enforces compile-time completeness for the 6 new variants. No reducer churn — `applyFilter` and `loadList` foundation methods untouched.
- Strangler-fig integrity: 4 new `:data` → `:shared` reaches (`UpdateComplaintUseCase` / `DeleteComplaintUseCase` shared with user-side §95, plus the foundation's `GetAllComplaintUseCase` reused for metadata re-fetch, plus `UserIdProvider` for `reasonAddedBy`). All four pre-bound `single` in `SharedModule`. The `Any`-typed legacy `metadata: Map<String, Any>?` is contained inside `:data`'s impl; the `:domain` API takes only `String reason`. Phase 9.x route-swap retires the legacy facade.
- Load-bearing fixes preserved: this slice touches NO load-bearing paths (no Coil, no per-host repo registry, no OkHttp interceptor, no Reader decoder hints, no `maxBitmapSize`, no AVIF decoder, no HighQualitySkiaImageDecoder, no Android RGB_565 / `allowHardware(false)` / OkHttp fetcher override, no CoilSourceHeaderInterceptor). No load-bearing risk.
- Sibling repository pattern (ISP §6): this slice's `AdminComplaintActionRepository` is the WRITE counterpart to the foundation's READ `AdminComplaintListRepository` AND the admin counterpart to user-side `ComplaintActionRepository`. Three repos in the complaint-rework family — `ComplaintActionRepository` (user-WRITE), `ComplaintListRepository` (user-READ), `AdminComplaintActionRepository` (admin-WRITE), `AdminComplaintListRepository` (admin-READ). Four siblings, four scopes, zero method-bleed.
- Metadata `Any` containment: the legacy `Complaint.metadata: Map<String, Any>?` is the only `Any` touched in this slice; it stays inside `:data`'s `addClosureReason` impl. The `:domain` API takes a `String reason`; the `:data` impl composes the legacy map with `reason` / `reasonAddedBy` / `reasonAddedAt` keys. No `Any` leaks across the `:data` boundary.
- `kotlin.time.Clock` convention: `:data` module convention is `import kotlin.time.Clock` + `import kotlin.time.ExperimentalTime` + `@OptIn(ExperimentalTime::class)` at the class level (verified against `ReadingSessionRepositoryImpl`). NOT `kotlinx.datetime.Clock` — that's a separate API surface. This convention was nearly violated mid-implementation but caught and fixed before the commit; documented here for future authors.
- Deferrals lifted to follow-on sub-slices: admin Edit (`admin.edit`), Bulk update/delete (`admin.bulk`), Statistics aggregation (`admin.stats`), Sort dropdown (`admin.sort`), App-version filter (`admin.versionfilter`), Long-press body-copy (`admin.copy`), i18n (Phase 10), Nav graph route-swap (Phase 9.x). All slot in via OCP §6 extension of the sealed Intent + Effect surfaces.
- Next-candidate block: per Rule 3, auto-continue. Natural strategic next slice:
  - **(A) `Phase 7.x.complaint.admin.edit`** — natural completion of the admin mutations triad. User-side §95 ported reply/edit/delete; admin §102 ported status-change/closure-reason/delete. Adding admin Edit harmonises the two surfaces. ~3-4 commits.
  - **(B) `Phase 7.x.complaint.admin.sort`** — sort dropdown sub-slice (7 sort modes). Smaller, self-contained.
  - **(C) `Phase 7.x.complaint.admin.stats`** — statistics aggregation card on top of the admin list.
  - **(D) `Phase 6.4.x.bookmark`** — long-deferred bookmark slice (currently in block-and-ask state per Task #217).
  - Recommended next: **Phase 7.x.complaint.admin.edit** — natural symmetry with user-side §95, completes the admin mutations triad, mirrors the predicted slice from foundation §101.9's deferral list.

## Phase 7.x.complaint.admin.edit — admin edit-complaint slice

Natural follow-on to §102's admin mutations triad. Adds a 4th admin mutation (edit subject + body) while preserving the legacy `metadata` field's closure-reason audit trail (the user-side §95 edit nulls metadata; admin edit MUST not). Reuses §102's existing `:data` infrastructure (`fetchLegacyById` helper + `legacyUpdate` collaborator) — zero new `:data` → `:shared` reaches. 6-commit plan collapsed to 4 source commits + close-out due to two bundle-forcing build constraints (documented in End-of-slice verdict).
